events.title: Swansons Nursery Model Train and Holiday Décor
events.desc: It’s the most magical time of the year! Swansons Nursery’s magical model train and holiday décor are back for the season. The train features a new theme every year, and this one is inspired by fairy tales. There’s even more to explore once you’ve spotted your favorite characters. Stop by the holiday yurt, write your postcard to Santa and make holiday art.

events.title: WildLanterns at Woodland Park Zoo
events.loc: Woodland Park Zoo , 5500 Phinney Ave. N., Seattle
events.desc: This is another tradition I look forward to every year. WildLanterns brings incredible lantern displays to Woodland Park Zoo, lighting up the night and making those 4:30 p.m. sunsets (almost) acceptable. Walk along the zoo’s paths to spot all seven continents represented with larger-than-life animal lanterns and immersive landscapes. Don’t miss the surprises in the Interactive Zone.

events.title: Bellevue Downtown Ice Rink
events.loc: Bellevue Downtown Park , 10201 N.E. Fourth St., Bellevue
events.desc: Bundle up! It’s opening weekend for the area’s largest seasonal ice-skating rink, making it the perfect opportunity to glide across the ice with the whole fam. On Sunday from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., WARM 106.9 will be on-site with a fun backdrop for photos (and swag for skaters!). Plan for an extra stop at the park’s Inspiration Playground — it’s one of my daughter’s favorites.

events.title: Seattle International Auto Show
events.cost: $19.75; ages 12 and younger free (discounts offered for seniors and military)
events.loc: Lumen Field , 800 Occidental Ave. S., Seattle
events.desc: Whether or not you’re in the market for a new car, this showcase will thrill the whole family. Take a nostalgic look at full-size cars paired with their collectible miniature counterparts in “Welcome to the Toybox.” Then head to the Family Fun Zone where kids can test out battery-powered cars on a special track, try out racing games and experience virtual reality.

events.title: Bel Arts Ballet ‘The Nutcracker’ at Crossroads Mall
events.loc: Crossroads Bellevue Shopping Center , 15600 N.E. Eighth St., Bellevue
events.desc: This free community performance is the perfect way to introduce the kids to the magic of “The Nutcracker.” Dancers bring the story of Clara and the Nutcracker to life as they travel to the Land of Sweets and meet whimsical characters along the way.

events.title: Wild Weather: A Children’s Planetarium Show
events.loc: Pierce College Science Dome , 9401 Farwest Dr. S.W., Lakewood
events.desc: My daughter has not yet asked me what the weather is like on the moon, but I wouldn’t be surprised if she did. This special planetarium show answers that very question with a closer look at weather on other planets and moons. It’s an interactive show that takes you through space to see snow, sandstorms and more.

events.title: Hmong New Year Celebration
events.loc: Seattle Center Armory , 305 Harrison St., Seattle
events.desc: This free festival honors Hmong community elders while celebrating the end of the harvest season and welcoming the new year. Experience the rich culture of the Hmong community with song and dance performances, traditional food and intricate fashion.

events.title: Dragon Parade
events.loc: McKinley neighborhood , East Harrison Street and East L Street, Tacoma
events.desc: Don’t be alarmed if you see a fire-breathing mechanical dragon roaming the streets of Tacoma, joined by the Tacomarama marching band. Just grab a lantern or glowstick of your own and join the lighted procession!

events.title: Edmonds Holiday Market
events.loc: Edmonds Historical Museum , 118 Fifth Ave. N., Edmonds
events.desc: Looking for something to bring to an upcoming holiday party or Thanksgiving dinner? This market will have baked goods and treats along with holiday greenery and other treasures. Pick something up for the holiday hostess with the mostess (or for yourself). Psst … Plan to spend the whole day in town, there’s so much to do .

events.title: Archaeology Family Day
events.cost: Included with admission ($24 for general admission; $16 for youth ages 4–14; free for ages 3 and younger) or membership
events.loc: Burke Museum , 4303 Memorial Way N.E., Seattle
events.desc: Professional archaeologists and researchers will be at the Burke Museum on Sunday, sharing their discoveries and research methods. Sort artifacts, watch a flintknapping demonstration and learn about ancient technologies. (And don’t miss the brand-new “Knowing Nature” exhibit on the museum’s second floor!)
